item.name: Drinking_Water_Dispensers
item.readyBeforeUse: The interiors and spigots are clean, and neither dispenser leaks.
item.readyForNextPerson: Both dispensers are full of potable water, their lids are closed, and neither dispenser leaks.
item.ifNotReady: If a dispenser is dirty or leaking, do not fill it. Tell the Dominatrix.
